# Simulation with UniPT method

```{r}
simulate_ppi_data_unipt <- function(M = 200, updated_stat,
                                    # Latent distributions:
                                    mu_theta0 = 4, sd_theta0 = 2,    
                                    mu_b = -0.1, sd_b = 0.1,       
                                    seed = NULL){
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  # BOOTSTRAP EXPERIMENTAL CONDITIONS
  n_real <- nrow(updated_stat)
  sampled_indices <- sample(seq_len(n_real), size = M, replace = TRUE)
  sim_settings <- updated_stat[sampled_indices, ]
  
  # Labeled Parameters (Local Labeled Stats)
  sig_y_lab <- sqrt(sim_settings$var_y_lab)
  sig_z_lab <- sqrt(sim_settings$var_z_lab)
  cov_lab   <- sim_settings$cov_yf_lab
  
  # Unlabeled Parameters (Local Unlabeled Stats)
  # var_Z_tilde is already the variance of the mean (s^2_unl / n_unl)
  # We use this directly to generate the noise for Z_tilde
  var_mean_unl <- sim_settings$var_Z_tilde
  
  # Global Parameter (Used only for Lambda denominator stability)
  var_f_pop <- sim_settings$var_f_global 
  
  # Sample Sizes
  n_lab <- sim_settings$n_labeled
  n_unl <- sim_settings$n_unlabeled
  
  # GENERATE LATENT VARIABLES
  true_mu_f     <- rnorm(M, mean = mu_theta0, sd = sd_theta0)
  true_raw_bias <- rnorm(M, mean = mu_b,      sd = sd_b)
  true_theta    <- true_mu_f + true_raw_bias
  
  # GENERATE OBSERVATIONS
  Y_bar_vec   <- numeric(M)
  Z_bar_vec   <- numeric(M)
  Z_tilde_vec <- numeric(M)
  
  for(i in 1:M) {
    # Labeled Data
    Sigma_lab <- matrix(c(sig_y_lab[i]^2, cov_lab[i], 
                          cov_lab[i],     sig_z_lab[i]^2), nrow=2) / n_lab[i]
    mu_vec <- c(true_theta[i], true_mu_f[i])
    obs_lab <- mvrnorm(1, mu = mu_vec, Sigma = Sigma_lab)
    Y_bar_vec[i] <- obs_lab[1]
    Z_bar_vec[i] <- obs_lab[2]
    
    # Unlabeled Data Generation
    Z_tilde_vec[i] <- rnorm(1, mean = true_mu_f[i], sd = sqrt(var_mean_unl[i]))
  }
  
  # CALCULATE PARAMETERS

  # Lambda Calculation
  # Numerator: Labeled Covariance
  # Denominator: We use Global Variance (var_f_pop) as the standard UniPT estimator
  weights <- (1/n_lab) + (1/n_unl)
  lambda_sim <- sum(cov_lab / n_lab) / sum(var_f_pop * weights)
  
  # UniPT Variances
  var_resid_tuned <- (sim_settings$var_y_lab + (lambda_sim^2 * sim_settings$var_z_lab) - (2 * lambda_sim * cov_lab))
  calc_lambda_var_b_hat <- var_resid_tuned / n_lab
  calc_lambda_var_theta_hat <- calc_lambda_var_b_hat + (lambda_sim^2 * var_mean_unl)
  

  df_sim <- data.frame(
    id = 1:M,
    n_labeled = n_lab,
    n_unlabeled = n_unl,
    
    # --- VANILLA ---
    b_hat = Y_bar_vec - Z_bar_vec,
    theta_hat = (Y_bar_vec - Z_bar_vec) + Z_tilde_vec,
    var_b_hat = sim_settings$var_b_hat,
    var_theta_hat = sim_settings$var_theta_hat,
    corr_theta_b = sim_settings$corr_theta_b,
    
    # --- UNIPT ---
    lambda_value = lambda_sim,
    lambda_b_hat = Y_bar_vec - lambda_sim * Z_bar_vec,
    lambda_theta_hat = (Y_bar_vec - lambda_sim * Z_bar_vec) + (lambda_sim * Z_tilde_vec),
    lambda_var_b_hat = calc_lambda_var_b_hat,
    lambda_var_theta_hat = calc_lambda_var_theta_hat,
    lambda_corr_theta_b = sqrt(calc_lambda_var_b_hat / calc_lambda_var_theta_hat),
    
    # --- CLASSIC (for baseline CI) ---
    Y_bar     = Y_bar_vec,                  # mean of labeled Y
    var_Y_bar = sim_settings$var_y_lab / n_lab,  # Var(mean) = Var(per obs)/n
    
    # --- TRUTH ---
    true_theta = true_theta,
    true_theta_0 = true_mu_f,
    true_b = true_raw_bias,
    true_b_lambda = true_theta - (lambda_sim * true_mu_f)
  )
  return(df_sim)
}
```

```{r}
estimate_all_priors <- function(data,u=50) {
  
  # A. Parametric Estimation (MLE)
  parametric_res <- estimate_parametric_mle(data$b_hat, sqrt(data$var_b_hat))
  
  # B. NPMLE Estimation
  # Note: Assuming GNmix_diffvar is loaded
  npmle_res <- GNmix_diffvar(data$b_hat, sqrt(data$var_b_hat), u, verbose = FALSE)
  
  # C. Parametric Estimation with UniPT
  parametric_unipt_res <- estimate_parametric_mle(data$lambda_b_hat, sqrt(data$lambda_var_b_hat))
  
  # B. NPMLE Estimation with UniPT
  # Note: Assuming GNmix_diffvar is loaded
  npmle_unipt_res <- GNmix_diffvar(data$lambda_b_hat, sqrt(data$lambda_var_b_hat), u, verbose = FALSE)
  
  # Return a structured list
  list(
    parametric = list(
      mu  = parametric_res$hat_mu_b,
      var = parametric_res$hat_var_b
    ),
    npmle = list(
      value = as.matrix(npmle_res$u),
      probability = npmle_res$fu
    ),
    parametric_unipt = list(
      mu  = parametric_unipt_res$hat_mu_b,
      var = parametric_unipt_res$hat_var_b
    ),
    npmle_unipt = list(
      value = as.matrix(npmle_unipt_res$u),
      probability = npmle_unipt_res$fu
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
calc_cis <- function(data, priors, 
                                mu_theta0 = 4, sd_theta0 = 2,    # theta0_j ~ N(4,4)
                                mu_b = -0.1, sd_b = 0.1, 
                                alpha = 0.05) {
  # =========================================================================
  # PART A: VANILLA METHODS (No Tuning)
  # =========================================================================
  
  # 0. TRUE prior (Oracle)
  ci_true_list <- mapply(
    FUN = function(beta, delta, seb, sed, rho) {
      cal_ci_parametric(mu_b, sd_b^2, beta, delta, seb, sed, rho, alpha)
    },
    beta = data$theta_hat, delta = data$b_hat, 
    seb = sqrt(data$var_theta_hat), sed = sqrt(data$var_b_hat), rho = data$corr_theta_b,
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  )
  ci_mat_true <- do.call(rbind, ci_true_list)
  colnames(ci_mat_true) <- c("lower", "upper")
  
  # 1. PPI CI
  ci_ppi_direct_list <- mapply(
    FUN = function(est, se) cal_ci_normal(est, se, alpha = alpha),
    est = data$theta_hat,
    se  = sqrt(data$var_theta_hat),
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  )
  ci_mat_ppi_direct <- do.call(rbind, ci_ppi_direct_list)
  colnames(ci_mat_ppi_direct) <- c("lower", "upper")
  
  # 2. CI with PARAMETRIC prior
  ci_param_list <- mapply(
    FUN = function(beta, delta, seb, sed, rho) {
      cal_ci_parametric(priors$parametric$mu, priors$parametric$var, 
                        beta, delta, seb, sed, rho, alpha)
    },
    beta = data$theta_hat, delta = data$b_hat, 
    seb = sqrt(data$var_theta_hat), sed = sqrt(data$var_b_hat), rho = data$corr_theta_b,
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  )
  ci_mat_param <- do.call(rbind, ci_param_list)
  colnames(ci_mat_param) <- c("lower", "upper")
  
  # 3. CI with NPMLE prior
  ci_npmle_list <- mapply(
    FUN = function(beta, delta, seb, sed, rho) {
      cal_ci_npmle(priors$npmle$value, priors$npmle$probability, 
                   beta, delta, seb, sed, rho, alpha)
    },
    beta = data$theta_hat, delta = data$b_hat, 
    seb = sqrt(data$var_theta_hat), sed = sqrt(data$var_b_hat), rho = data$corr_theta_b,
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  )
  ci_mat_npmle <- do.call(rbind, ci_npmle_list)
  colnames(ci_mat_npmle) <- c("lower", "upper")
  
  # =========================================================================
  # PART B: UNIPT METHODS (Tuned)
  # =========================================================================
  
  # 4. UniPT CI
  ci_unipt_direct_list <- mapply(
    FUN = function(est, se) cal_ci_normal(est, se, alpha = alpha),
    est = data$lambda_theta_hat,
    se  = sqrt(data$lambda_var_theta_hat),
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  )
  ci_mat_unipt_direct <- do.call(rbind, ci_unipt_direct_list)
  colnames(ci_mat_unipt_direct) <- c("lower", "upper")
  
  # 5. UniPT CI with PARAMETRIC prior
  ci_unipt_param_list <- mapply(
    FUN = function(beta, delta, seb, sed, rho) {
      cal_ci_parametric(priors$parametric_unipt$mu, priors$parametric_unipt$var, 
                        beta, delta, seb, sed, rho, alpha)
    },
    beta = data$lambda_theta_hat, delta = data$lambda_b_hat, 
    seb = sqrt(data$lambda_var_theta_hat), sed = sqrt(data$lambda_var_b_hat), rho = data$lambda_corr_theta_b,
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  )
  ci_unipt_mat_param <- do.call(rbind, ci_unipt_param_list)
  colnames(ci_unipt_mat_param) <- c("lower", "upper")
  
  # 6. UniPT CI with NPMLE prior
  ci_unipt_npmle_list <- mapply(
    FUN = function(beta, delta, seb, sed, rho) {
      cal_ci_npmle(priors$npmle_unipt$value, priors$npmle_unipt$probability, 
                   beta, delta, seb, sed, rho, alpha)
    },
    beta = data$lambda_theta_hat, delta = data$lambda_b_hat, 
    seb = sqrt(data$lambda_var_theta_hat), sed = sqrt(data$lambda_var_b_hat), rho = data$lambda_corr_theta_b,
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  )
  ci_unipt_mat_npmle <- do.call(rbind, ci_unipt_npmle_list)
  colnames(ci_unipt_mat_npmle) <- c("lower", "upper")
  
  # 7. Classic baseline 
  ci_classic_list <- mapply(
    FUN = function(est, se) cal_ci_normal(est, se, alpha = alpha),
    est = data$Y_bar, se = sqrt(data$var_Y_bar),
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  )
  ci_mat_classic <- do.call(rbind, ci_classic_list); colnames(ci_mat_classic) <- c("lower","upper")
  
  # =========================================================================
  # PART C: METRICS & RETURN
  # =========================================================================
  
  theta_true <- data$true_theta
  
  df_cov <- data.frame(
    cov_oracle        = ci_coverage(ci_mat_true,           theta_true),
    cov_ppi       = ci_coverage(ci_mat_ppi_direct,     theta_true),
    cov_parametric       = ci_coverage(ci_mat_param,          theta_true),
    cov_npmle            = ci_coverage(ci_mat_npmle,          theta_true),
    cov_unipt     = ci_coverage(ci_mat_unipt_direct,   theta_true),
    cov_unipt_parametric = ci_coverage(ci_unipt_mat_param,    theta_true),
    cov_unipt_npmle      = ci_coverage(ci_unipt_mat_npmle,    theta_true),
    cov_classic          = ci_coverage(ci_mat_classic,        theta_true)
  )

  df_len <- data.frame(
    len_oracle        = ci_avg_length(ci_mat_true),
    len_ppi      = ci_avg_length(ci_mat_ppi_direct),
    len_parametric       = ci_avg_length(ci_mat_param),
    len_npmle            = ci_avg_length(ci_mat_npmle),
    len_unipt     = ci_avg_length(ci_mat_unipt_direct),
    len_unipt_parametric = ci_avg_length(ci_unipt_mat_param),
    len_unipt_npmle      = ci_avg_length(ci_unipt_mat_npmle),
    len_classic          = ci_avg_length(ci_mat_classic)
  )

  df_ratio <- data.frame(
    ratio_oracle        = ci_mean_ratio(ci_mat_true,         ci_mat_classic),
    ratio_ppi       = ci_mean_ratio(ci_mat_ppi_direct,   ci_mat_classic),
    ratio_parametric       = ci_mean_ratio(ci_mat_param,        ci_mat_classic),
    ratio_npmle            = ci_mean_ratio(ci_mat_npmle,        ci_mat_classic),
    ratio_unipt     = ci_mean_ratio(ci_mat_unipt_direct, ci_mat_classic),
    ratio_unipt_parametric = ci_mean_ratio(ci_unipt_mat_param,  ci_mat_classic),
    ratio_unipt_npmle      = ci_mean_ratio(ci_unipt_mat_npmle,  ci_mat_classic)
  )
  
  # Return list of matrices and metrics
  list(
    coverage = df_cov,
    length   = df_len,
    length_ratio = df_ratio,
  
    oracle_parametric        = ci_mat_true,
    ppi       = ci_mat_ppi_direct,
    parametric        = ci_mat_param,
    npmle             = ci_mat_npmle,
    unipt     = ci_mat_unipt_direct,
    unipt_parametric  = ci_unipt_mat_param,
    unipt_npmle       = ci_unipt_mat_npmle,
    classic           = ci_mat_classic
  )
}
```

```{r}
run_many <- function(simulate_times,
                     M = 200,
                     updated_stat,
                     mu_theta0 = 4, sd_theta0 = 2,
                     mu_b = -0.1, sd_b = 0.1,
                     alpha = 0.05) {

  sim_idx <- seq_len(simulate_times)

  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = simulate_times, style = 3)
  on.exit(close(pb), add = TRUE)

  cov_cols <- vector("list", simulate_times)
  len_cols <- vector("list", simulate_times)
  lenratio_cols <- vector("list", simulate_times)

  for (i in sim_idx) {

    data <- simulate_ppi_data_unipt(M = M, updated_stat = updated_stat,
                                    mu_theta0 = mu_theta0,sd_theta0 = sd_theta0,
                                    mu_b = mu_b,sd_b = sd_b)

    priors <- estimate_all_priors(data)

    res_i <- calc_cis(data = data,priors = priors,
                      mu_theta0 = mu_theta0,sd_theta0 = sd_theta0,
                      mu_b = mu_b,sd_b = sd_b,alpha = alpha)

    cov_cols[[i]] <- t(res_i$coverage)
    len_cols[[i]] <- t(res_i$length)
    lenratio_cols[[i]] <- t(res_i$length_ratio)

    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
  }

  cov_mat <- do.call(cbind, cov_cols)
  len_mat <- do.call(cbind, len_cols)
  lenratio_mat <- do.call(cbind, lenratio_cols)

  colnames(cov_mat) <- paste0("sim", sim_idx)
  colnames(len_mat) <- paste0("sim", sim_idx)
  colnames(lenratio_mat) <- paste0("sim", sim_idx)

  cov_df <- as.data.frame(cov_mat)
  len_df <- as.data.frame(len_mat)
  lenratio_df <- as.data.frame(lenratio_mat)

  list(
    coverage = cov_df,
    length = len_df,
    length_ratio = lenratio_df
  )
}
```


Change sd_b from (0.01,0.03,0.05,0.1)
